policy: TFT Lab rules are the shared baseline; JCC official entity data and verified JCC-only mechanics override baseline math.

economy.coaching_note: When judging hold/sell/level/roll, compare interest breakpoints, +1 win gold, streak posture, and the value of seeing the next-level shop pool.

items.coaching_note: Item advice must distinguish final holders from temporary holders and check whether a remover/reforger exists before treating an item slam as reversible.

player_damage.known_rule: Losing PvP combat deducts player HP.
player_damage.stage_value_meaning: stage_value is the baseline Little Legend/player damage for the current stage; do not add a second Little Legend body-hit term.
player_damage.threshold_formula: max_alive_enemy_units_to_survive = max(0, hp - stage_value - 1); lethal_alive_enemy_units = max(0, hp - stage_value)
player_damage.pre_fight_policy: Use current HP and stage base damage to tell the user how many enemy units can survive before the loss becomes lethal; do not wait for post-fight survivor capture just to compute this advice.
player_damage.estimate_model: Before combat resolves, do not predict an exact future loss; compute the survival threshold and give a risk range over possible enemy survivor counts.
player_damage.jcc_validation: TFT Lab baseline; override with verified JCC official/live evidence if the mobile game differs.
player_damage.coaching_note: Phrase HP advice as tolerance lines, e.g. at 13 HP with stage base 10, two enemy survivors leaves 1 HP while three survivors is lethal; this is enough for greed/stabilize decisions.
